summary: Phase F12.1 VIP Leaderboard backend tests: created /app/backend/tests/test_phase_f12_1_vip_leaderboard.py with 18 pytest cases. All 18 PASSED against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Verified: stats.vip key + type + count consistency with segment=vip total; segment=vip filters rows to (total_sales>0 AND delivered_count>=1) — zero-sales and pending-only customers excluded; rows sorted strictly DESC by total_sales; 1-based contiguous `rank` field present; non-VIP segments (all/new/returning/imported) do NOT carry `rank`; pagination offset shifts the rank base (offset=3 -> rank starts at 4, offset=5 -> rank starts at 6); invalid segment=foo -> HTTP 422; auth guard (no token -> 401/403); multi-tenant isolation between admin@test.com and user2@test.com (user2 does not see admin's VIP seeds, stats differ). Seeded 7 shipments via direct Mongo (5 delivered VIP + 1 delivered-zero + 1 pending) and cleaned up on teardown.
critical_code_review_comments: audience.py list_audience uses FastAPI Query(regex=...) which still works but is deprecated in favour of `pattern=`. Non-blocking.
VIP filter/sort/rank logic is clean and correctly applied AFTER the segment filter but BEFORE pagination slicing — this is the right order for pagination-aware ranks.
seed_data_creation: 7 shipments seeded under admin@test.com via direct Mongo insert (TEST_VIP1..VIP5 delivered, TEST_NONVIP_ZERO delivered@0, TEST_NONVIP_PENDING pending@999) with module-scoped fixture that cleans up on teardown.
